about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One amendment to the signed task XC-82 (spec traceability): tools/interdeps.py, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/INTERDEPENDENCY.md join its scope. XC-82 creates tools/traceability.py. Measured on main 922836b with placeholder files at every path XC-82 names: interdeps --check fails with 'coverage: tools/traceability.py: no component covers it', and the docs-aligned job fails because docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's components table does not name the new module and docs/INTERDEPENDENCY.md is stale. None of the three files is in XC-82's scope, so the task cannot pass those CI jobs as signed. The same gap for XC-56 is proposed in PR 110. Nothing here is binding and CI does not read this file; it becomes part of the contract only when the owner key signs it into proofline.json.

changes.why: a new tools/ module needs an interdeps component, an architecture-page row and a regenerated map, or the interdeps and docs-aligned CI jobs fail
